basic_info.description: Mission Terrace Beauty - 1920s Spanish Mediterranean charm with modern updates. Features include a brick-fronted fireplace, built-ins, hardwood floors, double-pane windows, and an updated kitchen with stainless appliances. Two bedrooms + updated bath on the main level, plus two bonus rooms and an extra bath downstairs. Enjoy a large garage, level yard with garden beds, fruit trees, patio, and a detached cottage office. Close to Balboa Park, BART, Muni, and I-280.
